newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS upgrades United Grain Growers.
newsitem.headline: DBRS upgrades United Grain Growers.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Wednesday that it had upgraded United Grain Growers Ltd's long-term debt rating to BBB(low) from BB(high). The trend is listed as stable.
The DBRS also upgraded the commercial paper rating to R-2(middle), while the preferred share rating is confirmed at Pfd-4.

The company formed an alliance with Archer Daniels Midland Co, one of the largest food processing companies in the United States. The move will substantially improve the balance sheet and offer the potential for other long-term benefits, the service said.
